IH-05.duplicates_eliminated: Vortex packs on all platforms; CN 涡流指标; RU Вортекс robots.
IH-05.pine_code:
//@version=5
indicator("Vortex Indicator", overlay=false)
len = input.int(14, "Length")
vmPlus  = math.abs(high - nz(low[1]))
vmMinus = math.abs(low - nz(high[1]))
trSum = ta.sum(ta.tr(true), len)
vip = ta.sum(vmPlus, len) / trSum
vim = ta.sum(vmMinus, len) / trSum
plot(vip, "VI+", color=color.teal)
plot(vim, "VI-", color=color.red)
hline(1)

IH-06.name: True Strength Index (TSI)
IH-06.alt_names: 真实强度指数 · Индекс истинной силы
IH-06.origin: William Blau, TASC 1991; Momentum, Direction and Divergence (1995).
IH-06.core_idea: TSI double-smooths momentum (25/13 classic) and normalizes by double-smoothed absolute momentum, yielding an oscillator bounded near +/-100 that tracks trend quality with unusually low noise. Blau's design philosophy — smooth first, then normalize — makes TSI excellent for divergence work and as a momentum-of-trend confirmation.
IH-06.rules: Long on TSI crossing its signal line below zero in an uptrend regime; exit at signal re-cross or overbought roll.
IH-06.duplicates_eliminated: TSI packs everywhere; CN TSI策略; RU TSI форекс-роботы.
IH-06.pine_code:
//@version=5
indicator("True Strength Index", overlay=false)
lenL = input.int(25, "Long length")
lenS = input.int(13, "Short length")
sigLen = input.int(13, "Signal length")
m = ta.mom(close, 1)
tsiVal = 100 * ta.ema(ta.ema(m, lenL), lenS) / ta.ema(ta.ema(math.abs(m), lenL), lenS)
sig = ta.ema(tsiVal, sigLen)
plot(tsiVal, "TSI", color=color.teal)
plot(sig, "Signal", color=color.red)
hline(0)
hline(25)
hline(-25)

IH-07.name: Schaff Trend Cycle
IH-07.alt_names: 沙夫趋势循环 · Трендовый цикл Шаффа
IH-07.origin: Doug Schaff, 1999 (presented 2008; licensed to FXCM-era platforms).
IH-07.core_idea: A MACD output re-normalized through a stochastic of itself, cycling between 0-100 faster than MACD reacts: it behaves like a trend-aware oscillator whose 25/75 extremes mark pullback entries inside trends. Popular in forex and gold trading, especially in RU-language signal groups, as a MACD replacement with earlier turns.
IH-07.rules: Long on cycle crossing up from below 25 in a MACD-positive regime; short mirrored.
IH-07.duplicates_eliminated: STC ports across MT4/MT5/Pine; CN STC experiments.

IH-08.name: Connors RSI (Composite)
IH-08.alt_names: 康纳斯复合RSI · Композитный RSI Коннорса
IH-08.origin: Connors Research, 2012 (Larry Connors, Cesar Alvarez, Austin Lee).
IH-08.core_idea: A three-component composite: RSI(3) of price, streak-RSI (duration of consecutive up/down closes), and PercentRank of 1-day returns, averaged. It quantifies both stretch and abnormal one-day moves, producing sharper oversold readings than plain RSI for mean-reversion entries in the Connors program.
IH-08.rules: Long when composite < 15 with trend filter; exit on composite > 50-70; short mirrored.
IH-08.duplicates_eliminated: CRSI packs; CN 复合RSI; RU CRSI-роботы.

IH-09.name: Stochastic RSI
IH-09.origin: Tushar Chande & Stanley Kroll, The New Technical Trader (1994).
IH-09.core_idea: A stochastic applied to RSI rather than price, making the oscillator reach extremes far more often and earlier — useful for timing pullback entries inside established trends where raw RSI lags. It is the timing layer inside many trend-pullback hybrids and a default indicator on CN/RU platforms.
IH-09.rules: Long when stochRSI crosses up from < 20 while price is above the 200-MA; exit at 80+ cross down.
IH-09.duplicates_eliminated: Everywhere; CN KDJ-of-RSI variants; RU stochRSI скальпинг packs.

IH-10.name: Commodity Channel Index Systems
IH-10.alt_names: CCI顺势/回归系统 · Системы по CCI
IH-10.core_idea: CCI measures deviation of typical price from its SMA scaled by mean absolute deviation; Lambert's own framing was cyclical, but practice split it into a +/-100 breakout-trend system and a fade-at-extremes reversion system. The dual-personality is the reason it appears in both trend and reversion robots on CN and RU platforms.
IH-10.rules: Trend form: long on CCI > +100 (exit < -100); reversion form: fade CCI beyond +/-200 toward zero.
IH-10.duplicates_eliminated: CN CCI战法; RU CCI-советники; Woodie CCI variant (distinct calc, same idea).

IH-11.name: Chande Momentum Oscillator
IH-11.alt_names: 钱德动量摆动指标 · Осциллятор Чанде
IH-11.origin: Tushar Chande, TASC March 1994 (also the VIDYA author).
IH-11.core_idea: CMO sums up-moves and down-moves over N bars into a -100/+100 momentum read with a fixed scale — a cleaner RSI alternative intended for overbought/oversold and trend-momentum readings. It powers Chande's own VIDYA adaptive average and appears as a momentum gate in hybrid systems.
IH-11.rules: Trend-momentum: long when CMO > 50 (with trend filter); fade form: CMO extremes beyond +/-50 toward the mid.
IH-11.duplicates_eliminated: CMO in MetaStock-era libraries; CN CMO模板.

IH-12.name: Ultimate Oscillator
IH-12.alt_names: 终极摆动指标 · Ультимативный осциллятор
IH-12.core_idea: Blends buying-pressure averages over three weighted timeframes (7/14/28) to avoid the single-length trap; divergence between price and the composite is the primary signal. Williams designed it to catch accumulation/distribution phases that single-period oscillators miss, tying it loosely to his Wyckoff-influenced reading of markets.
IH-12.rules: Long on bullish divergence while UO < 30; exit at 50-70; short mirrored above 70.
IH-12.duplicates_eliminated: UO packs; CN 终极指标; RU UO-роботы.

IH-13.name: Long-Cycle Momentum Composites (KST / Coppock)
IH-13.alt_names: 长周期动量合成指标 · Долгосрочные осцилляторы
IH-13.origin: Coppock Curve: Edwin Coppock, Barron's 1962; KST: Martin Pring, 1990s.
IH-13.core_idea: Both aggregate multiple ROC lengths (Coppock: 14/11-month ROC smoothed by 10-month WMA; KST: four rate-of-change terms weighted) into slow momentum composites for monthly charts, designed around church-founding arithmetic in Coppock's case and cycle layering in Pring's. Signals are rare, zero-cross or turn-based, and act as regime context for shorter systems rather than standalone trades.
IH-13.rules: Long on curve turning up from below zero; exit on roll from above; use as regime gate.
IH-13.duplicates_eliminated: Coppock screeners; RU «кривая Коппока» long-term followers.

IH-14.name: Detrended Price Oscillator & Cycle Projection
IH-14.alt_names: 去趋势价格振荡器 · DPO и проекция циклов
IH-14.origin: 1980s cycle-analysis literature (Walter Bressert's work popularized the concept).
IH-14.core_idea: DPO shifts a displaced SMA to isolate the cycle component around a moving average, letting the analyst measure dominant cycle length and project the next trough/crest. Mechanically it feeds cycle-timed entries for oscillators (enter fades at projected troughs) rather than being traded on its own crossings. It is the practical bridge between Ehlers' DSP school and classic cycle-chart analysis.
IH-14.rules: Measure trough spacing on DPO; time mean-reversion entries near projected troughs; gate by cycle length stability.
IH-14.duplicates_eliminated: Bressert cycle tools; CN DPO周期模板; RU цикловый анализ.

VO-01.name: Volume Spread Analysis (VSA)
VO-01.origin: Tom Williams (ex-Wyckoff syndicate trader), Master the Markets (2003); software lineage TradeGuider; direct descent from PA-01/02.
VO-01.core_idea: VSA codifies Wyckoff reading into named bar patterns: 'no supply' (down bar, narrow spread, low volume at range lows — selling dried up), 'no demand' (up bar, narrow spread, low volume at highs), 'stopping volume' (climactic down bar absorbed), and 'effort vs result' anomalies. Systems trade the named setups with trend context. It is the single most-exported volume methodology to Russian and Chinese retail communities.
VO-01.rules: Long on 'no supply' after a downtrend with subsequent strength confirmation; short on 'no demand' after an up-leg; confirm with next-bar follow-through.
VO-01.key_parameters: Spread percentile and volume relative to 20-50 bar averages; trend context filter.
VO-01.duplicates_eliminated: VSA scripts (dozens of packs); CN 量价分析 school; RU VSA-сообщество (Smart-Lab's volume tradition); Wyckoff bar-reading (PA-02).

VO-02.name: On-Balance Volume Divergence
VO-02.origin: Joe Granville, 1963 (New Key to Stock Market Profits).
VO-02.core_idea: OBV accumulates signed volume; when price makes new highs/lows without OBV confirming, the move lacks participation and is prone to reversal — Granville's original 'OBV vs price' divergence. As a system it is a confirmation layer: trend entries require OBV agreement, and OBV non-confirmation flags exits. Granville's later salesmanship outran his statistics, but the mechanism survives in modern flow measures.
VO-02.rules: Compare 20-bar linreg slopes of price and OBV; divergence flags reversal candidates; confluence confirms trend entries.
VO-02.duplicates_eliminated: OBV in every platform; CN 能量潮战法; RU OBV-роботы; CMF/ADL cousins (MR-15).
VO-02.pine_code:
//@version=5
indicator("OBV Divergence Helper", overlay=false)
obv = ta.obv
obvSlope = ta.linreg(obv, 20, 0) - ta.linreg(obv, 20, 1)
priceSlope = ta.linreg(close, 20, 0) - ta.linreg(close, 20, 1)
bullDiv = priceSlope < 0 and obvSlope > 0
bearDiv = priceSlope > 0 and obvSlope < 0
plot(obv, "OBV", color=color.teal)
plotshape(bullDiv, "Bull div", shape.circle, location.bottom, color=color.teal, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(bearDiv, "Bear div", shape.circle, location.top, color=color.red, size=size.tiny)

VO-03.name: Chaikin Money Flow / Accumulation-Distribution Line
VO-03.alt_names: 蔡金资金流 · Линия A/D и CMF
VO-03.origin: Marc Chaikin, 1966-1980s (building on Granville OBV and Joe Joseph's work).
VO-03.core_idea: The A/D line weights each bar's volume by where close sits in its range (close-line location = buying pressure), and CMF normalizes it over 20 bars into a +/- oscillator. Sustained positive CMF during flat price flags accumulation — the classic 'smart money is buying the dip' read. It is a location-weighted OBV and inherits the same confirmation role.
VO-03.rules: Long when CMF > +0.25 with price basing; exit when CMF crosses down through zero after a run; divergence use as VO-02.
VO-03.duplicates_eliminated: ADL/CMF packs; CN CMF资金流策略; RU CMF-роботы.

VO-04.name: Money Flow Index
VO-04.alt_names: 资金流量指数 · Индекс денежного потока
VO-04.origin: Avinash 'Avi' Quong & Mehran Soudack, TASC August 1989 (a volume-weighted RSI).
VO-04.core_idea: MFI multiplies typical price by volume into 'money flow', then applies RSI math to positive vs negative flow days — producing an RSI-shaped oscillator that requires participation for extremes to register. MFI extremes with price non-confirmation are the volume-flavored divergence signal. As a fade system it mirrors MR-15's usage.
VO-04.rules: Long on MFI < 20 in uptrend regime; exit MFI > 50; divergence reading as primary use.
VO-04.duplicates_eliminated: MFI everywhere; CN MFI资金策略; RU MFI-скрипты.

VO-05.name: Volume Profile Nodes (HVN/LVN/POC)
VO-05.alt_names: 成交量分布节点 · Объёмный профиль (POC/HVN/LVN)
VO-05.origin: Market Profile descendant; volume-profile software (2000s: MarketDelta, Sierra) then Pine ports.
VO-05.core_idea: Histogram traded volume by price level; the Point of Control (heaviest node) acts as magnet and fair value, High-Volume Nodes as support/resistance shelf, and Low-Volume Nodes as vacuum zones price traverses quickly. Systems trade POC bounces in balance and LVN traversals toward the next node. Pine implementations estimate profiles from bar ranges — an approximation noted in code comments.
VO-05.rules: Long at HVN support under POC in balance; target the next HVN; break of POC with acceptance flips the balance area.
VO-05.key_parameters: Profile window 50-200 bars; bin count 24-100; acceptance = 2+ closes beyond.
VO-05.duplicates_eliminated: Volume profile packs (LuxAlgo, multiple); CN 成交量分布策略; RU объёмный профиль community.

VO-06.name: Market Profile TPO (Steidlmayer)
VO-06.origin: J. Peter Steidlmayer, CBOT, 1984 (with the CBOT's Market Profile concept letter).
VO-06.core_idea: TPO counts time-at-price in 30-minute brackets, defining value areas, one-timeelling rotations, and open types (open-drive, open-rejection, open-test). Steidlmayer's insight — the market's auction finds fair value where time accumulates — created a complete auction-theory framework. The systematic edges (value-area fades, initiative vs responsive opens) require session-TPO construction that Pine approximates poorly, so it remains mostly logic-only here.
VO-06.rules: Fade edges of the prior day's value area on responsive opens; join initiative moves that accept outside value.
VO-06.key_parameters: TPO period 30 min; value area 70% of TPO; open-type classification.
VO-06.duplicates_eliminated: TPO chart packs; RU аукционная теория followers; CN 市场轮廓 study groups.

VO-07.name: VWAP Deviation Bands (Execution-Grade)
VO-07.origin: Institutional execution analytics; popularized by VWAP-band scripts and Brian Shannon's teaching.
VO-07.core_idea: Session VWAP with standard-deviation bands turns the execution benchmark into a regime map: price above VWAP is a buy-the-dip day, below is sell-the-rip, band-3 extremes in balance are reversion candidates. Unlike MR-12 (pure fade), the band system's core rule is trade WITH the VWAP side and use bands for entry timing. It is the most-used institutional overlay on intraday desks.
VO-07.rules: Long dips to VWAP or -1 sigma while price holds above VWAP; fade -2/-3 sigma only in balance regimes; exit at VWAP cross against.
VO-07.key_parameters: Session VWAP; bands 1/2/3 sigma of (close - VWAP); regime by first-hour VWAP side.
VO-07.duplicates_eliminated: VWAP band packs; CN VWAP通道; RU VWAP-стратегии; anchored-VWAP variants (VO-08).
VO-07.pine_code:
//@version=5
indicator("Session VWAP + Deviation Bands", overlay=true)
b1 = input.float(1.0, "Band 1 (stdev)")
b2 = input.float(2.0, "Band 2 (stdev)")
v = ta.vwap(hlc3)
dev = ta.stdev(close - v, 50)
plot(v, "VWAP", color=color.orange)
plot(v + b1 * dev, "+1", color=color.new(color.teal, 40))
plot(v - b1 * dev, "-1", color=color.new(color.teal, 40))
plot(v + b2 * dev, "+2", color=color.new(color.red, 40))
plot(v - b2 * dev, "-2", color=color.new(color.red, 40))

VO-08.name: Anchored VWAP (AVWAP)
VO-08.origin: Brian Shannon, Maximum Trading Gains with Anchored VWAP (2020) — the formalization of a desk-era tool.
VO-08.core_idea: VWAP anchored not to the session but to a meaningful event (earnings gap, swing high/low, news) traces the average participation price since that event;AVWAPs from major pivots act as institutional memory levels that price respects or breaks meaningfully. Systems trade AVWAP bounces in trends and acceptance-through-AVWAP as regime shifts.
VO-08.rules: Anchor at event bars (user-defined or automated pivots); long retests of rising AVWAP in trend; exit on 2-bar acceptance through AVWAP against the trade.
VO-08.key_parameters: Anchor events; confluence of 2+ AVWAPs strengthens the level.
VO-08.duplicates_eliminated: AVWAP packs (Shannon-affiliated and clones); CN 锚定VWAP; RU якорный VWAP.

VO-09.name: Cumulative Delta Divergence (CVD)
VO-09.alt_names: 累计成交量差背离 · Кумулятивная дельта (CVD)
VO-09.origin: Footprint/order-flow software (2000s: MarketDelta, NinjaTrader Order Flow) — Pine approximates from bar microstructure.
VO-09.core_idea: Delta = aggressive buys minus aggressive sells (proxied in Pine by close-position-in-range heuristics); cumulative delta tracks net aggression. Divergences — price new high without delta confirmation — flag absorption by passive sellers, the modern footprint version of Wyckoff effort-vs-result. True tick-level CVD is unavailable in Pine, so implementations document the approximation honestly.
VO-09.rules: Long on bullish CVD divergence at support (price low, delta higher low); confirm with structure; exit on delta flip.
VO-09.key_parameters: Delta proxy: (close - low - (high - close)) / range x volume; divergence window 20-50 bars.
VO-09.duplicates_eliminated: CVD packs; CN 订单流/德尔塔 scripts; RU дельта-анализ (footprint communities).

VO-10.name: Klinger Volume Oscillator
VO-10.alt_names: 克林格成交量振荡器 · Осциллятор Клингера
VO-10.core_idea: KVO compares two EMAs of a 'volume force' (trend direction x volume x range position) to detect long-term accumulation/distribution turning points; signal-line crosses with divergence flag major reversals. It aims to catch the force behind trends before price confirms. Mostly used as confirmation context in hybrid systems.
VO-10.rules: Long on KVO crossing signal from below while price makes marginal lows (accumulation divergence); exit on signal re-cross.
VO-10.duplicates_eliminated: KVO packs; CN KVO指标; RU Klinger robots.

VO-11.name: Ease of Movement
VO-11.alt_names: 简易波动指标 · Индекс лёгкости движения
VO-11.origin: Richard Arms, 1970s (Arms also of TRIN fame).
VO-11.core_idea: EMV scales the mid-price change per bar by the inverse of volume per range unit — price traveling far on light volume scores high 'ease', implying an uncontested move. Arms' auction logic reads ease as sustainability. It is a niche confirmation oscillator today, surviving in scan stacks rather than as a standalone system.
VO-11.rules: Trend confirmation: EMV > 0 sustains longs in trend systems; negative cross flags fading drive.
VO-11.duplicates_eliminated: EMV in classic libraries; CN EMV模板.

VO-12.name: Volume-Weighted Momentum Breakout
VO-12.alt_names: 量价动量突破 · Объёмно-взвешенный пробой
VO-12.origin: Formalization of 放量突破 across CN platforms and OBV-breakout research in western scan communities.
VO-12.core_idea: A consolidated form of BK-08: enter breakouts only when a composite of volume surge, OBV slope, and CMF agrees — requiring the flow triad to confirm the price break. This reduces false breaks materially at the cost of later entries, and is the typical 'volume-confirmed breakout' template in Chinese factor workbooks.
VO-12.rules: Long on N-bar high with volume > k x avg, OBV slope > 0, CMF > 0; stop under breakout bar low.
VO-12.key_parameters: N 20-60; k 1.5-2; flow gates as above.
VO-12.duplicates_eliminated: BK-08; VO-02/03 combos; RU «пробой с потоком» scripts.

SE-01.name: Asia Range Sweep & London Reversal
SE-01.alt_names: 亚洲区间扫荡 · Съём азиатского диапазона
SE-01.origin: Forex session-structure practice (1990s-2000s desks); formalized in ICT materials (PA-09).
SE-01.core_idea: The Asian session builds a tight range of resting liquidity; London's first hours typically sweep one side of it before the real move — the sweep is entry fuel, not trend. Systems fade the sweep back through the range or trade the post-sweep continuation with the range midpoint as the discriminator. The mechanism is pure stop-cluster engineering on session boundaries.
SE-01.rules: Mark Asia range (00:00-07:00 UTC); on London open, fade a sweep of the range edge that fails within 2 bars; target range mid/other edge.
SE-01.key_parameters: Asia window 00:00-07:00 UTC; failure window 15-30 min; midpoint discriminator.
SE-01.duplicates_eliminated: ICT Judas swing (PA-09); RU «съём лоув/хай Азии» scripts; CN 亚盘区间策略.

SE-02.name: London Breakout («Лондонский взрыв»)
SE-02.origin: Classic forex strategy codified in Russian forums (2000s) and British prop-desk practice; one of the most-robotized session systems.
SE-02.core_idea: The Asia range defines the day's expected expansion; trade the break of its edges during the London window with stop at the opposite edge and target of one range height. Its Russian nickname 'London explosion' reflects its 2000s-era popularity on RU forex portals, and it remains the reference session-breakout template. Higher failure rates on quiet Mondays and news Fridays are standard caveats.
SE-02.rules: Range = Asia session high/low; enter on first close outside during 07:00-10:00 UTC; stop at range midpoint, target 1x range.
SE-02.duplicates_eliminated: RU «Пробой утреннего флэта» (RU-09, same mechanism on MOEX hours); CN 伦敦突破; every MT4 London-bot.
SE-02.pine_code:
//@version=5
strategy("London Breakout (Asia Range)", overlay=true)
asiaSess = input.session("0000-0700", "Asia range")
tz       = input.string("UTC", "Timezone")
inAsia  = not na(time(timeframe.period, asiaSess, tz))
var float aHi = na
var float aLo = na
if inAsia
aHi := na(aHi) ? high : math.max(aHi, high)
aLo := na(aLo) ? low  : math.min(aLo, low)
var bool tradedToday = false
newDay = ta.change(time("D")) != 0
if newDay
tradedToday := false
canTrade = not inAsia and not tradedToday and not na(aHi)
if canTrade and close > aHi
strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
tradedToday := true
if canTrade and close < aLo
strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
tradedToday := true
rng = aHi - aLo
if strategy.position_size > 0
strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=aLo, limit=aHi + rng)
if strategy.position_size < 0
strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=aHi, limit=aLo - rng)
plot(inAsia ? aHi : na, "Asia High", color=color.teal, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(inAsia ? aLo : na, "Asia Low", color=color.red, style=plot.style_linebr)

SE-03.name: NY Open Momentum (10:00 Rule)
SE-03.alt_names: 纽约开盘动量 · Моментум открытия Нью-Йорка
SE-03.origin: US equity intraday desk lore (1990s-2000s); quantified in the overnight/intraday literature (Lou-Polk-Skouras, 2019).
SE-03.core_idea: The first 90 minutes of NY hours carry disproportionate volume and price discovery; the direction established by 10:00 with confirmation holds disproportionately often to the close. The systematic form enters with the 10:00 direction when the open range and VWAP side agree. On reversal days the failure itself is informative — hence the strict invalidation rules.
SE-03.rules: At 10:00 ET, take the direction of the open range side if price and VWAP agree; stop at open range mid; exit 15:45 ET.
SE-03.key_parameters: Open range 09:30-10:00; VWAP confluence; time-stop EOD.
SE-03.duplicates_eliminated: IB/ORB variants (BK-01); CN 美股开盘策略; RU «Нью-Йорк открытие» bots.

SE-04.name: Overnight vs Intraday Edge (Tug of War)
SE-04.alt_names: 隔夜与日内收益差 · Овернайт-эффект
SE-04.origin: Lou, Polk & Skouras, 'A Tug of War: Overnight Versus Intraday Expected Returns', JFE 2019.
SE-04.core_idea: US equity returns have accrued almost entirely overnight for decades while intraday returns favor momentum names — a structural split linked to who trades when (retail vs institutional windows). The systematic form holds positions only overnight in night-favoring names and only intraday in day-favoring ones. Pine can express the timing shell, though multi-asset ranking needs a screener.
SE-04.rules: Classify asset by historical overnight vs intraday mean dominance; hold overnight-only for night-winners (buy close, sell open), intraday-only for day-winners.
SE-04.key_parameters: Estimation window 1-3 years; rebalance monthly; borrow/fee awareness essential.
SE-04.duplicates_eliminated: Buy-the-close-sell-the-open papers; CN 隔夜效应研究; RU овернайт-стратегии on SPB panel.

SE-05.name: Turn-of-Month / Turn-of-Quarter Effect
SE-05.alt_names: 月末效应 · Эффект конца месяца
SE-05.origin: Ariel (1987), Lakonishok & Smidt (1988) documentation; institutional cash-flow timing as the driver.
SE-05.core_idea: Equity returns concentrate in the last trading day(s) and first 3-4 days of the month, attributed to institutional funding cycles, 401k/pension inflows, and index rebalancing. The systematic form is long-only across the turn-of-month window and flat or hedged otherwise. It is among the most persistent calendar anomalies documented across markets.
SE-05.rules: Enter long at T-1 of month end; exit at T+3; optionally hedge (index short) outside the window.
SE-05.key_parameters: Window T-1..T+3; skip months with major scheduled shocks (per user risk policy).
SE-05.duplicates_eliminated: TOQ/TOY variants; CN 月末效应研究; RU месячные окна стратегии.

SE-06.name: Sell in May / Halloween Indicator
SE-06.alt_names: 五月卖出效应 · Эффект 'Продавай в мае'
SE-06.origin: Bouman & Jacobsen, 'The Halloween Indicator, Sell in May and Go Away', American Economic Review 2002.
SE-06.core_idea: November-April historically outperforms May-October across many markets for decades; Bouman-Jacobsen verified the effect in 37 countries and tied it loosely to vacation-liquidity seasons. As a system it is a binary annual regime gate — hold risk assets November-April, rotate to defensives or cash otherwise. Best treated as a tilt, not a standalone edge.
SE-06.rules: Long risk assets Nov 1 - Apr 30; rotate to cash/bonds/defensive sectors May-Oct.
SE-06.key_parameters: Hemisphere-adjusted variant; combine with momentum for robustness.
SE-06.duplicates_eliminated: Seasonal rotation ETF strategies; CN 五穷六绝七翻身 folklore systematized; RU сезонность studies.

SE-07.name: Pre-FOMC Announcement Drift
SE-07.alt_names: 美联储议息前漂移 · Пре-FOMC дрифт
SE-07.origin: Lucca & Moench, NY Fed Staff Report 2011 / Journal of Finance 2015.
SE-07.core_idea: US equities exhibit a large, statistically robust drift upward in the hours before scheduled FOMC announcements — documented since 1980 across 100+ meetings — interpreted as pre-announcement risk-premium compensation. The systematic form is long the index from the morning of announcement day (or 2 hours pre-release) and flat after the release. One of the cleanest central-bank calendar effects ever documented.
SE-07.rules: Long SPX/ES from 10:00-14:00 ET window before the 14:00 statement; exit at release or shortly after; skip unscheduled/emergency meetings.
SE-07.key_parameters: FOMC calendar; entry window per the paper; skip days with concurrent major data.
SE-07.duplicates_eliminated: ECB/pre-announcement drift follow-up studies; CN 美联储会议策略; RU пред-FOMC стратегии.

SE-08.name: Hour-of-Day Volatility Breakout
SE-08.alt_names: 时段波动突破 · Внутричасовой пробой
SE-08.core_idea: Volatility clusters at session open/close and lunch lulls elsewhere; systems trade breakouts only during high-energy windows (first/last 90 minutes) and trade range-fades during the midday lull. The insight is that the same breakout signal has different expectancy by clock hour, so the calendar acts as a signal multiplier.
SE-08.rules: Enable breakout logic in 09:30-11:00 and 14:30-16:00 windows; switch to band-fade logic 11:30-14:00.
SE-08.key_parameters: Hour buckets per market; window tuning by ATR percentile.
SE-08.duplicates_eliminated: Session-filter modules in CN/RU robots; ICT kill zones (PA-09) overlap.

SE-09.name: Crypto Weekend & Funding Window Effects
SE-09.alt_names: 加密周末与资金费率窗口 · Крипто-сезонность
SE-09.origin: Crypto market-structure research (2019+ exchange papers; funding-settlement timing on perpetuals).
SE-09.core_idea: Crypto exhibits weekend liquidity holes, Sunday-gap behavior, and volatility bursts around perpetual funding settlements every 8 hours; systems harvest the predictable windows: fade weekend illiquidity extremes before Monday re-liquidity, or trade funding-settlement micro-drift. The effects decay as market structure matures — a documented feature of young markets.
SE-09.rules: Fade weekend range extremes toward the weekend VWAP with tight targets; avoid holding majors through Monday open gaps; optional funding-window scalps.
SE-09.key_parameters: Weekend window Sat 00:00 - Mon 00:00 UTC; funding times 00/08/16 UTC; slippage-aware sizing.
SE-09.duplicates_eliminated: Funding-window bots; CN 周末行情策略; RU крипто-сезонность notes.

GR-01.name: Classic Spot Grid Bot
GR-01.alt_names: 网格交易机器人 · Сеточный робот
GR-01.origin: Manual grid trading since the 1970s US commodity floors; industrialized by crypto exchange bot marketplaces (2019+), JoinQuant/myquant templates, and 3Commas/Pionex products.
GR-01.core_idea: Lay N limit buys below and sells above a base price at fixed percentage steps; every filled buy is paired with a sell one step higher, harvesting oscillation regardless of direction. Profit per cycle = step x quantity, risk = full inventory in a sustained trend against the ladder. Variants differ in step definition (fixed %, ATR, Fib levels) and range-reset logic.
GR-01.rules: Base position at start; buy each grid down, re-sell each filled rung one grid up; reset the grid when price exits the configured range.
GR-01.key_parameters: Grid count 10-100; step 0.5-2% (crypto), 0.2-0.5% (majors); order size = capital / grid count.
GR-01.duplicates_eliminated: CN 网格交易 (myquant/JoinQuant templates, E大网格体系); RU «сеточные роботы» (Binance/Bybit RU marketplaces); every Pionex/3Commas preset.
GR-01.pine_code:
//@version=5
strategy("Spot Grid Bot (Ladder)", overlay=true, pyramiding=30)
gridCount = input.int(10, "Grid levels")
stepPct   = input.float(1.0, "Grid step, %")
qtyPct    = input.float(10.0, "Order size, % of equity")
var float lastBuy = na
qty() => (strategy.equity * qtyPct / 100) / close
if strategy.position_size == 0
strategy.entry("G0", strategy.long, qty=qty())
strategy.exit("TP0", from_entry="G0", limit=close * (1 + stepPct / 100))
lastBuy := close
if strategy.position_size > 0 and not na(lastBuy) and close <= lastBuy * (1 - stepPct / 100) and strategy.opentrades < gridCount
id = "G" + str.tostring(strategy.opentrades)
strategy.entry(id, strategy.long, qty=qty())
strategy.exit("TP" + str.tostring(strategy.opentrades), from_entry=id, limit=close * (1 + stepPct / 100))
lastBuy := close

GR-02.name: Martingale / Averaging-Down Systems
GR-02.alt_names: 马丁格尔加仓 · Мартингейл / усреднение
GR-02.origin: 18th-century French casino theory; industrialized by MT4-era advisors — most famously the Ilan family (RU-02) — and every forex 'recovery' EA.
GR-02.core_idea: Double (or multiply) size at fixed adverse intervals so the basket's breakeven converges toward current price; the win rate is very high until a sustained trend vaporizes the account. The modern trade-off versions (Ilan's RSI+CCI gating, ATR spacing, equity stop) merely delay the tail. Documented here because it remains one of the most-sold strategy families in RU and CN retail markets — with the explicit warning that its risk-adjusted profile is negative without a hard equity stop.
GR-02.rules: Initial position; add size^k at each N-ATR adverse step; exit the basket at breakeven + spread; HARD equity stop at max drawdown.
GR-02.key_parameters: Multiplier 1.5-2.5; step 0.5-1.5 ATR; max steps 6-10; equity stop mandatory.
GR-02.duplicates_eliminated: Ilan 1.6/2.0 & Apocalypse (RU-02); CN 马丁/扛单 systems; every 'recovery zone' EA on MQL5 market.
GR-02.pine_code:
//@version=5
strategy("ATR Martingale Averager (RISK DEMO)", overlay=true, pyramiding=10)
mult    = input.float(2.0, "Size multiplier")
stepAtr = input.float(1.0, "Add every N ATR")
atr = ta.atr(14)
if strategy.position_size == 0
strategy.entry("M1", strategy.long, qty=1)
if strategy.position_size > 0 and close <= strategy.position_avg_price - stepAtr * atr
strategy.entry("M" + str.tostring(strategy.opentrades + 1), strategy.long,
qty=math.pow(mult, strategy.opentrades))
if strategy.position_size > 0 and close >= strategy.position_avg_price + 0.25 * atr
strategy.close_all(comment="Basket recovery")

GR-03.name: Anti-Martingale Pyramiding
GR-03.origin: Turtle doctrine (TR-02); formal risk literature favoring pyramiding into winners.
GR-03.core_idea: The mirror of GR-02: add to winners at fixed favorable intervals with unit sizing constant or declining, so risk concentrates behind the trend rather than behind hope. Drawdown geometry is bounded while upside compounds — the mathematically sound side of the averaging debate. Turtles added 0.5N units; equity-curve variants gate adds on system performance.
GR-03.rules: Add a unit each +0.5N-1R advance up to a cap; trail stops on the whole stack at 2N from the last fill.
GR-03.key_parameters: Add interval 0.5N-1R; unit cap 3-4; stack trailing stop.
GR-03.duplicates_eliminated: Turtle pyramiding (TR-02); trend-add modules in CN CTA kits; RU «доливка по тренду» practice.

GR-04.name: DCA & Smart DCA Bots
GR-04.alt_names: 定投与智能定投机器人 · DCA-боты
GR-04.origin: Dollar-cost averaging canon (Graham-era); bot-marketplace industrialization (2019+); CN 定投 practice (E大长赢体系) and RU T-Bank auto-invest.
GR-04.core_idea: Scheduled buys regardless of price, optionally with valuation gates ('smart' variants buy more when price is below a moving anchor or index percentile). The edge is behavioral discipline plus volatility harvesting on the cost basis, not timing. Smart variants (valuation-triggered, dip-multiplied) blur into GR-01 grid logic at the margins.
GR-04.rules: Buy fixed amounts on schedule; smart variants scale the tranche by (anchor / price) or z-score below fair value; rebalance or take-profit rules vary.
GR-04.key_parameters: Frequency weekly/monthly; valuation multiplier 1-3x; take-profit band 20-50% (CN 定投止盈 convention).
GR-04.duplicates_eliminated: CN 基金定投+止盈体系; RU T-Bank auto-invest strategies; 3Commas DCA presets.

GR-05.name: Fibonacci Grid
GR-05.origin: Fibonacci retracement practice merged with grid automation (MT4 era); popular in RU forex communities.
GR-05.core_idea: Anchor a Fibonacci retracement on the last impulse and place grid orders at the classic ratios (38.2/50/61.8/78.6), trading reversals at each level toward the impulse origin or breakouts beyond 100%. It converts a discretionary drawing tool into an automatic ladder. The edge is crowd-level self-fulfillment at famous ratios, which decays in fast markets.
GR-05.rules: Anchor pivots define the retracement; buy limits at 38.2/50/61.8 with stops beyond 78.6; targets at 0% then extensions.
GR-05.key_parameters: Impulse pivot selection (zigzag 3-8%); ratio set; per-level sizing.
GR-05.duplicates_eliminated: RU «сетка по Фибо» robots; CN 斐波那契网格 experiments; MT4 Fibo-grid EAs.

GR-06.name: ATR-Adaptive Grid
GR-06.alt_names: ATR自适应网格 · Адаптивная сетка по ATR
GR-06.origin: Grid-bot engineering iteration (2020s crypto bot marketplaces; CN grid research notes).
GR-06.core_idea: Replace the fixed percentage step with k x ATR so grid density self-adjusts to volatility: wide grids in storms (fewer, cheaper fills), tight grids in calm. Range bounds can follow Bollinger/Keltner envelopes, making the grid a volatility-adaptive oscillator harvester. This is the most robust of the grid family because it prices risk in the same units as the market's own motion.
GR-06.rules: Step = k x ATR(14) recomputed at reset; range = EMA +/- m x ATR; reset grid when price exits the envelope.
GR-06.key_parameters: k 0.5-1.5; m 2-3; reset on envelope break.
GR-06.duplicates_eliminated: Volatility-grid presets in bot marketplaces; CN 自适应网格研究; RU адаптивные сетки.

GR-07.name: Portfolio Rebalancing Bot
GR-07.alt_names: 组合再平衡机器人 · Ребаланс-боты
GR-07.origin: Shannon's Demon (Claude Shannon & Thomas Cover, 1970s lectures) as the theory; BitUniverse 'Grid Trading Battle' era (2019) as the retail phenomenon.
GR-07.core_idea: Hold fixed value weights across assets; periodic or threshold rebalancing systematically sells winners and buys losers, harvesting the volatility of the pair (Shannon's demon: an unlevered volatile pair grows wealth under rebalance alone). The 2019-2021 BitUniverse rebalance battles made it a retail staple in CN and RU crypto circles. Its edge equals pair volatility minus rebalance costs.
GR-07.rules: Rebalance to target weights when any weight drifts beyond a threshold or on a schedule; cash leg optional as the stable asset.
GR-07.key_parameters: Threshold 5-20% absolute drift; rebalance fee-awareness; asset pair volatility screen.
GR-07.duplicates_eliminated: Shannon's demon writeups; BitUniverse battles; CN 定投再平衡 hybrids; RU ребалансировка боты.

CN-01.name: Chan Theory (缠论): Fractals, Pens, Pivots & Three Buy/Sell Points
CN-01.alt_names: 缠论：分型、笔、中枢与三类买卖点
CN-01.origin: The blogger 缠中说禅 (Chan Zhongshuo Chan), serial essays 2006-2008 (教你炒股票 series).
CN-01.core_idea: Chan theory builds a strictly nested structure: K-lines merge (处理包含), top/bottom fractals (分型) chain into pens (笔), pens into segments (线段), and the overlap of three consecutive sub-moves defines a pivot zone (中枢). Trades are the three buy points: first buy at the pivot's trend-exhaustion divergence, second on the failed retest low, third on the pullback that holds above the pivot after breakout. Its rigor and completeness made it China's dominant native TA framework, now industrialized in open source.
CN-01.rules: Build fractal/pen/segment structure; locate 中枢 [ZG, ZD]; buy-3 when price breaks above ZG then pulls back holding above ZG; mirror for sell-3; MACD divergence confirms buy-1/sell-1.
CN-01.key_parameters: Pen thresholds (5+ bars); pivot overlap rule; level nesting 1m/5m/30m/daily (多级别联立).
CN-01.duplicates_eliminated: czsc (waditu/czsc — 200+ signal functions, Rust core); chanlun-pro (gaoxiaojun) with JoinQuant/Broker adapters; 缠论 indicator packs on 通达信; no western equivalent (pivot-breakout SMC is a loose cousin).
CN-01.pine_code:
//@version=5
strategy("Chanlun-style Pivot (Zhongshu) Breakout", overlay=true)
segLen = input.int(10, "Segment window")
atr = ta.atr(14)
// Overlap of three consecutive segment ranges approximates the zhongshu
hi1 = ta.highest(high, segLen)
lo1 = ta.lowest(low, segLen)
hi2 = ta.highest(high, segLen)[segLen]
lo2 = ta.lowest(low, segLen)[segLen]
hi3 = ta.highest(high, segLen)[2 * segLen]
lo3 = ta.lowest(low, segLen)[2 * segLen]
zg = math.min(hi1, math.min(hi2, hi3))
zd = math.max(lo1, math.max(lo2, lo3))
hasPivot = zg > zd
var bool broke = false
if hasPivot and close > zg
broke := true
thirdBuy  = broke and low > zg and close > open
thirdSell = not hasPivot or close < zd
if thirdBuy and strategy.position_size <= 0
strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if thirdSell and strategy.position_size > 0
strategy.close("L", comment="Pivot invalidated")
plot(zg, "ZG (pivot top)", color=color.teal)
plot(zd, "ZD (pivot bottom)", color=color.red)

CN-02.name: Limit-Up Board Tactics (打板：首板/连板/接力)
CN-02.origin: 宁波涨停板敢死队 (Ningbo 'death squad') era, early 2000s; codified in 淘股吧/游资 literature.
CN-02.core_idea: The 10% daily limit creates a queue-auction: a stock sealing the limit signals one-sided demand that cannot clear until the next day, and 连板 (consecutive limit streaks) mark the momentum lifecycle of speculative cycles. 打板 buys the seal itself or the next day's open on strength; 首板/连板 classifications and 情绪周期 (CN-05) govern which day of the cycle is tradeable. This is the purest momentum strategy extant anywhere — and the most dependent on exchange microstructure.
CN-02.rules: Detect limit-close (close == limit price); enter next open if sentiment regime supports continuation; exit on a non-limit close, failure to seal intraday, or time stop.
CN-02.key_parameters: Limit 10% (main board) / 20% (ChiNext/STAR); sentiment gates (前日连板高度, 跌停家数); no short side (A-share constraint).
CN-02.duplicates_eliminated: Every A-share 打板 screener (同花顺/通达信 formulas); BigQuant limit-up factors; not replicable on unlimited markets (the limit IS the edge).
CN-02.pine_code:
//@version=5
strategy("Limit-Up Board Continuation (打板, generalized)", overlay=true)
limitPct = input.float(10.0, "Daily limit %")
tol = input.float(0.002, "Price tolerance")
lim = close[1] * (1 + limitPct / 100)
limitUp = close >= lim * (1 - tol) and close == high
firstBoard = limitUp and not limitUp[1]
if firstBoard
strategy.entry("L", strategy.long, comment="Next-open continuation")
if strategy.position_size > 0 and not limitUp
strategy.close("L", comment="No follow-through")
if strategy.position_size > 0 and nz(ta.barssince(firstBoard)) > 3
strategy.close("L", comment="Time stop")

CN-03.name: Limit-Up Pullback Re-entry (涨停回马枪)
CN-03.origin: A-share swing community (2010s WeChat 战法 literature); also a standard TDX formula.
CN-03.core_idea: After a limit-up marks institutional arrival, the stock typically digests for days; the trade buys the controlled pullback to the 10/20-day MA while the limit-up's volume signature stays constructive, targeting the retest of the spike high. It converts the emotional limit-up event into a measured swing entry, and is among the most-shared CN formulas.
CN-03.rules: A limit-up within the last 5-8 bars; pullback touches MA(10/20) with shrinking volume; long on a bullish reclaim bar; stop under pullback low.
CN-03.key_parameters: Lookback 5-8; MA 10/20; volume contraction < 0.7 x spike-day volume.
CN-03.duplicates_eliminated: 回踩战法 variants; 强势股回调买入 templates; TDX 回马枪 formulas (same pattern).
CN-03.pine_code:
//@version=5
strategy("Limit-Up Pullback Re-entry (回马枪)", overlay=true)
limitPct = input.float(10.0, "Daily limit %")
lookback = input.int(6, "Recent limit-up within N bars")
maLen = input.int(20, "Pullback MA")
lim = close[1] * (1 + limitPct / 100)
limitUp = close >= lim * 0.998 and close == high
recentBoard = nz(ta.barssince(limitUp)) <= lookback
ma = ta.sma(close, maLen)
pullback = recentBoard and low <= ma and close > ma and volume < ta.sma(volume, 5)
if pullback and strategy.position_size == 0
strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
atr = ta.atr(14)
if strategy.position_size > 0 and close < strategy.position_avg_price - 2 * atr
strategy.close("L", comment="Stop")

CN-04.name: Dragon-Head Leading-Stock Tactics (龙头战法)
CN-04.origin: 游资 (hot-money) tradition, 淘股吧 era; popularized by traders like 炒股养家 (public posts, 2010s).
CN-04.core_idea: Within a speculative theme, the dragon head (leading stock) absorbs the majority of capital attention and keeps rising while followers die first; the strategy identifies the theme's first limit-up stock with sector resonance, buys its continuation or its first strong pullback, and rides until 龙头首阴 (the leader's first big bearish candle) or sentiment top. It is CANSLIM's leadership principle (TR-18) weaponized on limit-up mechanics with an explicit sentiment lifecycle.
CN-04.rules: Identify theme + first/strongest limit-up with sector breadth; enter continuation boards or first MA pullback; exit on leader's first bearish engulfing or sentiment peak signals (CN-05).
CN-04.key_parameters: Sector resonance >= 3 limit-ups; leader relative strength top 1%; exit discipline on 首阴.
CN-04.duplicates_eliminated: CANSLIM (TR-18) structural cousin; CN 主升浪战法; 打板 (CN-02) entry mechanics.

CN-05.name: Sentiment Cycle Model (情绪周期)
CN-05.alt_names: 情绪周期：冰点→发酵→高潮→退潮
CN-05.origin: 游资 community synthesis (2010s; 炒股养家, 淘县 school).
CN-05.core_idea: A-share speculation moves through observable phases — 冰点 (freeze: limit-up count collapses), 发酵 (fermentation: leaders emerge), 高潮 (climax: broad limit-up waves, high 连板 heights), 退潮 (ebb: leaders fail, 跌停 clusters) — measured by daily limit-up/limit-down counts, board heights, and 炸板率 (failed seals). The model is a market-regime gate: 打板/接力 strategies trade only in fermentation-climax phases and stand down in ebb. It is sentiment quantification with a uniquely CN data basis.
CN-05.rules: Compute daily limit-up count, max board height, failed-seal rate; classify phase; enable aggressive tactics only in fermentation/climax; flip to defensive in ebb/freeze.
CN-05.key_parameters: Thresholds on counts/heights (e.g., climax: 100+ limit-ups, height >= 5); phase persistence filters.
CN-05.duplicates_eliminated: 连板高度 monitoring dashboards; BigQuant sentiment factors; no direct western analog (closest: breadth-thrust regime models).

CN-06.name: Chip Distribution (筹码分布 / CYQ)
CN-06.origin: 陈浩 (Chen Hao) & 天狼50 school, 2000s; implemented in 指南针/通达信 indicators.
CN-06.core_idea: A cost-basis distribution estimated from historical volume assuming round-trip decay: each price level holds the shares believed to be held there, forming peaks at congestion and valleys at fast moves. Reads: 筹码单峰密集 (single-peak concentration) precedes breakouts, 主力低位吸筹 shows mass migrating to lows, and 获利盘比例 (profit-holder ratio) drives resistance. It is a uniquely CN institutional-psychology lens on volume.
CN-06.rules: Estimate the chip distribution (triangular decay over ~60-120 bars); trade breakouts from single-peak zones or profit-ratio thresholds (e.g., sell when 90%+ in profit into resistance).
CN-06.key_parameters: Decay factor ~0.5-0.8 per turnover; estimation window 60-250 bars.
CN-06.duplicates_eliminated: CYQ/SCR indicator clones; 筹码峰 formulas in TDX; volume-profile (VO-05) is the western statistical cousin.

CN-07.name: Dragon-Tiger List Following (龙虎榜跟随)
CN-07.origin: SSE/SZSE disclosure rules (2010s formalization); 集思录/淘股吧 tracking communities.
CN-07.core_idea: Exchanges disclose daily the top broker-branch flows behind abnormal moves; famous 游资 seats have trackable styles, so strategies follow disclosed net-buyers of specific seats into the next session (or fade notorious sellers). It is flow-copy trading with an official data source — a transparency artifact unique to A-shares.
CN-07.rules: Nightly, parse 龙虎榜 disclosures; if known-strong seats net-buy heavily, enter next open with limit-up-cycle regime gate (CN-05); exit per 打板 rules.
CN-07.key_parameters: Seat whitelist/blacklist; position sizing by seat conviction; next-open entry discipline.
CN-07.duplicates_eliminated: 席位跟踪 dashboards (问财/开盘啦); not portable without disclosure data.

CN-08.name: Northbound Capital Following (北向资金跟随)
CN-08.origin: Stock Connect launch (2014/2016); HKEX daily flow disclosure; CN quant community adoption.
CN-08.core_idea: Northbound (HK->mainland) flows were visible daily and acquired a 'smart money' halo; strategies follow sustained northbound net-buying per stock or rotate into the most-bought constituents. Academic evidence on the flow's alpha is mixed, and the 2024 disclosure-frequency cut (daily to quarterly for holdings) degraded most implementations — an instructive archive lesson in data-regime risk.
CN-08.rules: Track daily northbound net flow by stock; enter sustained multi-day accumulation names with trend filter; exit on flow reversal or target.
CN-08.key_parameters: Flow threshold vs free float; persistence 3-5 days; regime filter.
CN-08.duplicates_eliminated: 北向资金实时 tracking tools (pre-2024); 外资流入 strategies on JoinQuant/BigQuant.

CN-09.name: Margin Balance Sentiment (融资融券情绪)
CN-09.origin: Margin trading pilot 2010; CNKI/HSE-style academic studies and platform factors.
CN-09.core_idea: Margin financing balance (融资余额) proxies leveraged retail bullishness; rising balances with flat price flag hidden demand, while falling balances in rallies warn of weak conviction. Systematic uses include leverage-sentiment regime gates for rotation strategies and per-stock margin-buy screening. It is the CN analog of US margin-debt sentiment studies.
CN-09.rules: Gate rotation strategies by aggregate 融资余额 trend; screen stocks with rising margin balance + price base; exit when balance rolls over.
CN-09.key_parameters: Balance percentile windows 20-60 days; index-level regime gates.
CN-09.duplicates_eliminated: 两融数据 factor studies (华泰金工 reports); platform sentiment factors.

CN-10.name: Double-Low Convertible Bonds (双低可转债)
CN-10.origin: 集思录 community canon (2014+); 小散/掌村 bloggers' formalization.
CN-10.core_idea: CB double-low = price + conversion premium x 100; the lowest double-low bonds combine bond-floor protection with equity optionality, and rotating monthly into the cheapest decile historically compounded at equity-like rates with far smaller drawdowns. Add-ons include 强赎 (forced redemption) avoidance and 下修 (reset) event anticipation. It is China's most distinctive quant-retail success story — a genuinely unique instrument-driven strategy.
CN-10.rules: Rank all CBs by price + 100 x conversion premium; hold the bottom N equal-weighted; rebalance monthly; exclude bonds near forced-redemption triggers.
CN-10.key_parameters: N 5-20; rebalance weekly/monthly; filters: size, rating, redemption distance.
CN-10.duplicates_eliminated: 集思录轮动 dashboards; 双低 variants (低价/低溢价 separable); CB wheel strategies.

CN-11.name: Large/Small-Cap Rotation (大小盘轮动)
CN-11.origin: Academic and 券商金工 research (2010s); JoinQuant/BigQuant template staple.
CN-11.core_idea: Relative momentum (or valuation spread) between CSI 300 and CSI 500/1000 governs which cap bucket leads multi-month cycles; the rotation form holds the leading index (or its ETF) with monthly rebalance, optionally gated by volatility or M2/credit regime. The 2016-2017 and 2013 cycles are the canonical case studies.
CN-11.rules: Compute 3-12 month relative strength (or PE/PB spread percentile) 300 vs 500/1000; hold the winner's ETF; rebalance monthly with hysteresis.
CN-11.key_parameters: Lookback 3-6 months; hysteresis band 5-10%; vol gate optional.
CN-11.duplicates_eliminated: 行业轮动 (CN-12) at sector scale; global size-factor rotation (ST-04/05).

CN-12.name: Sector Rotation (行业轮动)
CN-12.origin: JoinQuant's ten canonical strategies list; 券商金工 sector-momentum reports (华泰/国盛).
CN-12.core_idea: Rank SW/CITIC industry indices by multi-window momentum (or by fundamental momentum: earnings revision + price), rotate into the top 3-5 industries monthly. CN implementations add policy-sentiment overlays because sector moves are policy-driven. The mechanism is standard cross-sectional momentum (ST-04) applied to industry indices.
CN-12.rules: Rank industries by 3+6 month momentum; hold top k ETFs; monthly rebalance; optional drawdown stop.
CN-12.key_parameters: Momentum windows 3/6/12; k 3-5; transaction-cost aware rebalance.
CN-12.duplicates_eliminated: ST-04 cross-sectional momentum (same mechanism); US sector-rotation literature.

CN-13.name: Index Enhancement (指数增强)
CN-13.origin: CN quant-fund industry practice (2010s); JoinQuant template #7.
CN-13.core_idea: Track a benchmark (CSI 300/500) while adding tilts — multi-factor stock selection, T+0 intraday enhancement on the base position (CN-21), and allocation timing — to beat the index by a few percent annually. It is not one algorithm but a framework: benchmark replication + alpha overlays. Listed here because CN platforms treat it as a canonical strategy class.
CN-13.rules: Hold index-tilted portfolio (factor tilts, see ST entries); harvest intraday enhancement via 做T; hedge tail with index futures when allowed.
CN-13.key_parameters: Tracking-error budget 2-5%; factor tilt weights; hedge ratio.

CN-14.name: Alpha Strategy with Index-Futures Hedge (阿尔法策略)
CN-14.origin: JoinQuant's canonical ten (myquant docs); 2010-2015 IF-era golden age.
CN-14.core_idea: Long a stock basket selected to beat the index, short the corresponding index future (IF/IC/IM), isolating pure alpha from market beta. The strategy's Chinese golden age ended with the 2015 futures restrictions (discounts, position limits), after which the basis cost ate much of the alpha — a documented lesson in regulatory risk. Still taught as the fundamental market-neutral template.
CN-14.rules: Construct positive-alpha basket (multi-factor, CN-15); short equivalent index futures; roll contracts; manage basis risk.
CN-14.key_parameters: Basket beta targeting; hedge ratio 0.8-1.0; roll calendar.
CN-14.duplicates_eliminated: ST statistical arb at index level; global 130/30 and market-neutral funds.

CN-15.name: Multi-Factor Stock Selection (多因子选股)
CN-15.origin: JoinQuant canonical ten; 华泰金工/国盛金工 factor research series; WorldQuant BRAIN CN community.
CN-15.core_idea: Score stocks by combined factors (value, growth, quality, momentum, liquidity, reversal) with industry/size neutralization, hold the top decile with periodic rebalance. The CN twist: reversal and small-cap factors historically dominated, and Barra-style CN risk models are public via 券商 reports. It is the industrial backbone of CN quant equity.
CN-15.rules: Compute factor z-scores with winsorization/neutralization; composite score; hold top N monthly; rebalance with cost control.
CN-15.key_parameters: Factor set per Barra-CN; weighting IC-weighted or equal; rebalance monthly.
CN-15.duplicates_eliminated: ST-04..ST-11 factor entries (the global canon of the same idea); WorldQuant 101 Alphas (ST-10).

CN-16.name: MA Convergence Breakout (均线粘合突破)
CN-16.origin: CN platform-era 战法 (TDX/同花顺 formula canon).
CN-16.core_idea: When 5/10/20/60-day MAs converge within a few percent of each other, trend disagreement has collapsed — energy coiled; the first close above the bundle with volume marks the release. It is a moving-average-systems' answer to the squeeze (MR-05) and behaves like a base-breakout with self-drawn boundaries.
CN-16.rules: Detect MA bundle spread < 3% of price; long on close above the highest MA with volume > 1.5x; stop under bundle mid.
CN-16.duplicates_eliminated: BK-09 box breakout (same coiling mechanism); CN 平台突破 with MA flavor.
CN-16.pine_code:
//@version=5
strategy("MA Convergence Breakout (均线粘合突破)", overlay=true)
ma1 = ta.sma(close, 5)
ma2 = ta.sma(close, 10)
ma3 = ta.sma(close, 20)
ma4 = ta.sma(close, 60)
hiMa = math.max(ma1, math.max(ma2, math.max(ma3, ma4)))
loMa = math.min(ma1, math.min(ma2, math.min(ma3, ma4)))
spread = (hiMa - loMa) / close
glued = spread < 0.03
if glued and close > hiMa and volume > 1.5 * ta.sma(volume, 20)
strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
atr = ta.atr(14)
if strategy.position_size > 0 and close < strategy.position_avg_price - 2 * atr
strategy.close("L", comment="Stop")

CN-17.name: N-Structure Tactics (N字战法)
CN-17.origin: CN swing community canon (波段 literature, 2010s).
CN-17.core_idea: An N is the minimal trend unit — up-move, retracement holding above the prior low, then new high — and consecutive qualified Ns define the trend's health. The trade buys the breakout of the retracement's start-level after a qualifying retrace, with stops under the N's low. It is essentially a measured swing-continuation grammar, the CN retail mirror of Brooks' H1 logic (PA-05).
CN-17.rules: Detect impulse, retrace (0.38-0.618 or MA touch), trigger on close above retrace start; stop under retrace low; project next N.
CN-17.key_parameters: Retrace bounds 0.38-0.618; volume contraction on retrace.
CN-17.duplicates_eliminated: PA-05 Brooks H1/H2; flag patterns; 缠论笔结构 (CN-01) at coarser granularity.

CN-18.name: Rising Pullback System (上升回档)
CN-18.origin: 经传软件 (JingChuan) teaching system; CN retail platform canon.
CN-18.core_idea: In an uptrend defined by a proprietary combination (e.g., 智能交易线 smart line + 操盘线), buy the pullback that touches the rising guide line with a reversal candle, sell into strength at the upper channel. The software packaged wave-riding into a two-line discipline that millions of CN retail users learned. Mechanically it is a Keltner-ish pullback (MR-04) with CN branding.
CN-18.rules: Trend = price above rising guide MA; buy on pullback touch + reversal; exit at upper band or trend-line break.
CN-18.duplicates_eliminated: MR-04 Keltner pullback; CN 波段王 (CN-20) overlap.

CN-19.name: Main-Force Accumulation Tracking (主力吸筹跟踪)
CN-19.origin: 庄股-era analysis tradition (1990s-2000s); indicator canon (主力进出/吸筹 formulas).
CN-19.core_idea: Institutional accumulation leaves signatures: price resists falling on bad days, volume creeps up without price progress, large-order net inflows persist — reads formalized into CN indicators (主力吸筹, 大单净量). Systems screen for the signature cluster and position ahead of the markup phase. It is Wyckoff accumulation (PA-01) translated into CN order-flow proxies.
CN-19.rules: Screen: large-order net inflow positive N days + price flat/down + volatility contraction; enter on breakout of accumulation range.
CN-19.key_parameters: Large-order threshold (10万+ tickets proxy); persistence 5-10 days.
CN-19.duplicates_eliminated: PA-01/PA-02 Wyckoff; VO-03 CMF accumulation reads; CN-06 chip distribution confirmation.

CN-20.name: Swing Band System (波段操作 / 波段王)
CN-20.origin: CN retail platform canon (波段王 named systems across TDX-era software).
CN-20.core_idea: A two-line channel system: hold longs while price rides above a rising guide line inside the upper half of a 20/60 band, exit into the upper extreme, re-enter at mid-band pullbacks. It packages swing trading into visual band discipline for non-technical users. The mechanism is envelope-based swing riding (MR-04/BK-13 duality applied to swings).
CN-20.rules: Long from mid-band pullback while guide line rises; exit at upper band extreme or guide-line break.
CN-20.duplicates_eliminated: MR-04/BK-13 Keltner forms; CN-18 rising pullback (same anatomy).

CN-21.name: Intraday T+0 Around Base Position (底仓做T)
CN-21.origin: A-share T+1 workaround culture; JoinQuant/uqer enhancement templates.
CN-21.core_idea: Holding a base position, each day the trader sells a portion on intraday strength and rebuys on weakness (or buys dips and sells into strength), ending flat-to-base daily — manufacturing T+0 economics inside a T+1 regime. Systematic forms trigger on VWAP deviation bands (VO-07) or opening-range logic with hard same-day round-trip discipline. It is the standard 'enhancement' overlay of CN-13.
CN-21.rules: Base position held; intraday: sell k% into +2 sigma strength or buy into -2 sigma weakness; restore base by close.
CN-21.key_parameters: k 10-30% of base; sigma bands; skip on limit-up/down days.
CN-21.duplicates_eliminated: VO-07/SE-08 intraday shells; CN-13 enhancement module.

CN-22.name: Call-Auction & Tail-Session Tactics (集合竞价/尾盘战法)
CN-22.origin: A-share session microstructure practice; 打板 ecosystem components.
CN-22.core_idea: The 09:15-09:25 call auction reveals overnight order intent (竞价异动), and the 14:30-15:00 tail session reveals institutional commitment because T+1 sellers have finished — strategies read auction imbalance for gap plays and buy 尾盘 strength for next-day continuation, the classic 尾盘买入法. Both exploit session-boundary information asymmetry unique to CN trading hours.
CN-22.rules: Auction form: enter open on auction volume surge + gap in sentiment regime (CN-05 gate); tail form: buy last-30-min strength with closing push, exit next open/first strength.
CN-22.key_parameters: Auction volume multiple; 尾盘 window 14:30-15:00; next-day exit discipline.
CN-22.duplicates_eliminated: SE-03 open-momentum logic; CN-02 continuation boards.

CN-23.name: Calendar Spread Arbitrage (跨期套利)
CN-23.origin: JoinQuant canonical ten (myquant docs); CN futures desk practice (IF/IC era 2010s).
CN-23.core_idea: Trade the spread between contract months of the same underlying: the near-far spread mean-reverts around a cost-of-carry band, so fades at band extremes harvest mispricing while directional traders use spread momentum as a regime signal. Rebar/rebar and IF/IF spreads are the classic CN teaching cases. Pure statistical arbitrage at single-asset-family scale.
CN-23.rules: Model carry band; fade spread beyond +/-k sigma; hold to mean or carry rationalization; roll awareness.
CN-23.key_parameters: Sigma 1.5-2.5; lookback 20-60 days; liquidity per leg.
CN-23.duplicates_eliminated: ST-01/02 stat-arb machinery; CN-24/25 sibling arb forms.

CN-24.name: Cross-Commodity Spreads (跨品种套利)
CN-24.origin: CN futures tradition (油粕比, 螺纹-热卷, 豆油-棕榈 pairs); myquant templates.
CN-24.core_idea: Related commodities keep process-driven ratios (soybean meal/soybean oil crush spread; rebar/hot-rolled coil mill spread); trade ratio deviations toward fundamental anchors with hedge sizing by beta. CN commodity desks treat these as the canonical 'industrial logic' arb — the spread's mean is explainable, not just historical.
CN-24.rules: Compute ratio (or dollar-neutral spread); trade beyond k-sigma with fundamental checkpoint (process margins extreme); exit at mean or margin reversion.
CN-24.key_parameters: Ratio z-score window 60-120; hedge ratio by beta; margin-extreme confirmation.
CN-24.duplicates_eliminated: ST-01 pairs (statistical form); RU Brent-Urals (RU-12) — same construct, different commodities.

CN-25.name: Futures-Cash Basis Arbitrage (期现套利)
CN-25.origin: IF/IC launch 2010; ETF creation-basket arb practice; myquant templates.
CN-25.core_idea: When index futures premium exceeds carry + costs, short the future and buy the cash basket (ETF); the convergence at expiry locks the premium. Reverse-cash arbitrage was long blocked by shorting constraints, making CN basis arb structurally one-sided — a regulatory artifact documented in every CN derivatives textbook. The 2015 restrictions' discounts made the reverse trade briefly viable for hedged funds.
CN-25.rules: Monitor basis vs fair carry; execute basket-vs-future when premium > threshold; hold to convergence or unwind at reversion.
CN-25.key_parameters: Threshold = carry + 2x costs; basket replication error; roll rules.
CN-25.duplicates_eliminated: ST-16 roll yield (related mechanics); global index-arb literature.

CN-26.name: Valuation-Band Rotation (估值分位轮动)
CN-26.origin: 果仁网/且慢-era strategy canon; E大长赢体系 style percentile practice.
CN-26.core_idea: Rotate between equity and bond/cash using the index's historical PE/PB percentile: buy equities under the 30th percentile, scale out above the 70th, hold otherwise. It is the CN retail answer to valuation-timing research, popularized through ETF portfolios because it requires no individual-stock skill. The edge is cyclical patience, not prediction — and it is the most-used 'smart beta' discipline among CN long-term retail investors.
CN-26.rules: Compute 10-year PE/PB percentile of target index; scale equity weight in bands (e.g., 0-30%: full; 30-70%: half; 70-100%: defensive); rebalance quarterly.
CN-26.key_parameters: Percentile windows 5-10 years; band thresholds; bond/cash leg choice.
CN-26.duplicates_eliminated: CN-11 rotation (momentum flavor); global value-timing research; GR-04 smart DCA anchors.

RU-01.name: Elder's Triple Screen
RU-01.origin: Alexander Elder (b. Leningrad), 1985 articles; Trading for a Living (1993).
RU-01.core_idea: Three timeframes in a fixed hierarchy: the weekly chart sets trend (screen 1), the daily oscillator times pullbacks against it (screen 2), and intraday triggers the entry (screen 3) — never fight the higher tide, buy the dip with the tide. Elder, a Russian-born New York psychiatrist, gave retail trading its most teachable multi-timeframe discipline, and no system is more universally cited in RU-language education.
RU-01.rules: Weekly trend up (EMA-26 rising) + weekly oscillator oversold + daily tick up: long; weekly trailing stop at 2 x ATR(13); short mirrored.
RU-01.key_parameters: Weekly EMA 26; weekly stochastic 14; daily force index/RSI-2 trigger; stop 2 x ATR(13).
RU-01.duplicates_eliminated: Countless RU/EN course versions; HTF-filter trend-pullback hybrids globally; SafeZone stops are Elder's exit companion (RU-04).
RU-01.pine_code:
//@version=5
strategy("Elder Triple Screen", overlay=true)
wkUp = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W",
ta.ema(close, 26) > ta.ema(close, 26)[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
wkStoch = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W",
ta.stoch(close, high, low, 14), lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
dailyTrigger = ta.rsi(close, 2)
atr = ta.atr(13)
buySetup  = wkUp and wkStoch < 30 and dailyTrigger > nz(dailyTrigger[1]) and close > open
sellSetup = not wkUp and wkStoch > 70 and dailyTrigger < nz(dailyTrigger[1]) and close < open
if buySetup
strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if sellSetup
strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
if strategy.position_size > 0
strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=strategy.position_avg_price - 2 * atr)
if strategy.position_size < 0
strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=strategy.position_avg_price + 2 * atr)
if strategy.position_size > 0 and wkStoch > 70
strategy.close("L", comment="Weekly OB")
if strategy.position_size < 0 and wkStoch < 30
strategy.close("S", comment="Weekly OS")

RU-02.name: Ilan Family (RSI + CCI Martingale Advisors)
RU-02.origin: MT4-era RU forex forums (~2008-2010); Ilan 1.6 Dynamic the canonical build; Ilan 2.0 documented on MQL5 (RSI + CCI oscillators); 'Apocalypse' a known modification.
RU-02.core_idea: The most famous RU-language advisor lineage: enter on oscillator oversold (RSI + CCI confluence), then pyramid with multiplied lots at fixed adverse spacing until the basket recovers — GR-02's martingale geometry wrapped in an oscillator trigger. Its ubiquity made it the archetype teachers use to explain why martingales die, and its surviving forks all add equity stops. Documented as the RU contribution to retail automation history.
RU-02.rules: Long when RSI < buy level and CCI < -100; add size^k at each N-ATR adverse step (max steps); basket take-profit at breakeven + margin; hard equity stop.
RU-02.key_parameters: RSI 14/30-level, CCI 14/-100; step ~30-50 pips original; multiplier 1.4-2.0; max 6-8 steps.
RU-02.duplicates_eliminated: GR-02 martingale (the mechanism); 'Apocalypse' and every Ilan fork; CN 扛单 systems (same geometry).
RU-02.pine_code:
//@version=5
strategy("Ilan-style RSI+CCI Martingale (RISK DEMO)", overlay=false, pyramiding=8)
rsiL = input.int(14, "RSI length")
cciL = input.int(14, "CCI length")
buyLv = input.float(30, "RSI buy level")
stepAtr = input.float(1.0, "Spacing (ATR)")
sizeMult = input.float(1.4, "Lot multiplier")
r = ta.rsi(close, rsiL)
c = ta.cci(close, cciL)
atr = ta.atr(14)
if strategy.position_size == 0 and r < buyLv and c < -100
strategy.entry("I1", strategy.long, qty=1)
if strategy.position_size > 0 and close <= strategy.position_avg_price - stepAtr * atr and strategy.opentrades < 8
strategy.entry("I" + str.tostring(strategy.opentrades + 1), strategy.long,
qty=math.pow(sizeMult, strategy.opentrades))
if strategy.position_size > 0 and close >= strategy.position_avg_price + 0.3 * atr
strategy.close_all(comment="Basket TP")

RU-03.name: Sniper Method («Снайпер», Дмитриев / Байнов)
RU-03.origin: Pavel Dmitriev, on the basis of Pyotr Baynov's «Мясо» system; RU forex portals (2010s).
RU-03.core_idea: A level-only scalping method (no indicators, no news): identify 'total' impulse levels on higher timeframes (M15/H1 relative to the M1/M5 working chart), then trade precise break or bounce of those levels with strict SL/TP arithmetic. Its branding emphasizes single-shot precision — one planned entry per level with predefined risk. It represents the RU school of level-geometry scalping, cousins of western supply/demand (PA-07) but with codified level hierarchy.
RU-03.rules: Mark impulse levels from higher-TF swings; on the working TF trade the touch: bounce form enters at the level with stop behind it, break form waits for a close-through with retest entry.
RU-03.key_parameters: Level TF hierarchy M1/M5 working vs M15/H1 reference; stop beyond level; TP 1-2x stop.
RU-03.duplicates_eliminated: PA-07 supply/demand zones; «Мясо» (parent system); RU Sniper X derivatives.

RU-04.name: Elder SafeZone Stops & Elder Ray
RU-04.origin: Alexander Elder, Come Into My Trading Room (2002).
RU-04.core_idea: SafeZone computes stops from the average of recent adverse excursions multiplied by a coefficient, so stops sit just beyond normal noise rather than at arbitrary percentages; Elder Ray decomposes price into buying/selling power relative to a 13-day EMA to visualize bull/bear strength. Together they are Elder's answer to exit engineering, and RU/EN course materials treat them as a package with Triple Screen.
RU-04.rules: Stop = highest recent adverse-move average x coefficient (2.0-2.7) below price in longs, ratcheting; use Elder Ray extremes as exit confluence.
RU-04.duplicates_eliminated: Chandelier exit (TR-10) — same adaptive-stop family; ATR-trail systems.

RU-05.name: Order-Book (Стакан) Scalping on MOEX Futures
RU-05.origin: MOEX derivatives market culture (2000s+); Smart-Lab scalping threads; proprietary desk lineage.
RU-05.core_idea: Si/RTS/Br futures scalpers read the DOM (стакан): large resting bids/offers, their pulls, and aggressive prints crossing the spread signal short-term direction; manual scalpers fade spoofed walls and join genuine absorption, while semi-automatic 'стакан+lenta' (book+tape) hybrids automate the read. It is the RU native order-flow school — footprint trading at the source rather than through proxies.
RU-05.rules: Read ladder: fade large one-sided walls that fail to trade; join sweeps that lift multiple levels; exit within seconds-to-minutes on tape slowdown.
RU-05.key_parameters: DOM depth 5-20 levels; print-rate thresholds; latency budget < 10 ms for automation.
RU-05.duplicates_eliminated: VO-09 CVD (Pine proxy of the same information); HFT spoofing-detection literature.

RU-06.name: Synthetic Bond Arbitrage («SyntheticBondsArbitrage»)
RU-06.origin: Smart-Lab.ru community (lectures and the SyntheticBondsArbitrage robot, 2010s-2020s).
RU-06.core_idea: Construct a 'synthetic bond' from a futures position plus a money-market leg (or from OFZ vs futures basis), harvesting the difference between implied financing in the futures basis and the actual deposit/REPO rate. Smart-Lab's robot lineage automates the roll-calendar and basis-monitoring logic. It is the MOEX version of the global cash-and-carry trade (CR-02's ancestor) adapted to Russian rate mechanics.
RU-06.rules: Monitor futures basis vs fair carry; long bond/short future (or reverse) when basis deviates beyond costs; roll calendar-aware.
RU-06.key_parameters: Cost threshold; REPO rate benchmark; roll dates; margin efficiency.
RU-06.duplicates_eliminated: ST-16 roll-yield; CR-02 cash-and-carry; RU-12 spread family.

RU-07.name: Dividend-Gap Trading (Дивидендный гэп)
RU-07.origin: MOEX practice (2000s+); T-Bank/Smart-Lab community canon — a genuinely RU-specific institutional artifact.
RU-07.core_idea: MOEX equities drop by the declared dividend on the registry-close date, and the gap's refill speed varies with dividend yield, market phase, and tax regime: high-yield blue chips refill fastest. Classic plays: (a) 'cut the coupon' — hold through the gap only when taxes/fees make the dividend worthwhile; (b) gap-refill — buy the gap down, target the refill over days-to-weeks; (c) post-gap drift trades on refill statistics. The strategy's statistics are published annually in RU media because the pattern is structural to the exchange.
RU-07.rules: Build the registry calendar; measure gap size vs ATR; buy refill candidates (high yield, uptrend, index-heavy) at the gap open; target full or 50% refill; stop beyond 1.5x gap.
RU-07.key_parameters: Yield screen > 6-8%; refill window 2-30 sessions; tax-aware holding period.
RU-07.duplicates_eliminated: BK-10 gap playbook (general form); CN 分红除权 practices (structurally similar, different regime).

RU-08.name: Pairs Trading on MOEX Equities
RU-08.origin: Gatev et al. (ST-01) mechanics adapted by the RU quant community (2010s Smart-Lab/TSLab threads).
RU-08.core_idea: Cointegration pairs of sector twins (Сбербанк ordinary vs preferred, Лукойл/Роснефть, Norilsk/Rusal proxies) with spread z-score entries; the RU specifics are fat-tailed event risk (sanctions, dividends) and ordinary-vs-preferred (ао-ап) pairs whose spread embeds governance discount. TSLab/StockSharp implementations handle the two-leg execution and hedge rebalancing.
RU-08.rules: Estimate hedge ratio (rolling OLS/Kalman); enter at z +/- 2; exit z = 0; hard stop z = 3.5 or fundamentals-break veto.
RU-08.key_parameters: Estimation 250-500 days; z windows 20-60; event-veto list.
RU-08.duplicates_eliminated: ST-01/ST-03 (the general mechanism); CN-24 cross-commodity analog.

RU-09.name: Morning Flat Breakout («Пробой утреннего флэта»)
RU-09.origin: RU forex/QUIK-era intraday canon (2000s); MOEX-hours adaptation of the London breakout.
RU-09.core_idea: The first hour of MOEX cash-equity trading (10:00-11:00 MSK) typically builds a flat; its break with momentum frequently drives the first leg of the day. The robotized form trades stop orders at the flat edges with tight invalidation. It is SE-02's mechanism on Moscow hours, kept as a separate entry because the community treats it as a distinct canon with its own statistics.
RU-09.rules: Range = 10:00-11:00 MSK extremes; enter on break during 11:00-14:00; stop at range midpoint; target 1-1.5x range.
RU-09.key_parameters: Range window 60 min; skip news days; volume confirmation optional.
RU-09.duplicates_eliminated: SE-02 London breakout (same mechanism); BK-01 ORB (session-open family).

RU-10.name: Russian Ichimoku Schools (Ишимоку-школы)
RU-10.origin: RU Ichimoku course tradition (2000s+, translators of Hosoda; dedicated RU portals).
RU-10.core_idea: The RU community institutionalized Ichimoku with its own conventions: mandatory chikou-span clearance rules, 'three pillars' trend grading by cloud color and Kijun slope, and conservative 'signal only when price is beyond BOTH spans' filters. The system traded is TR-11's, but the RU school's added discipline layers (entry only after cloud exit + pullback to Kijun) deserve separate documentation as the canonical CIS variant.
RU-10.rules: Trade only with cloud bias; entry on Kijun pullback with Tenkan cross; stop beyond the cloud edge; add on Chikou clearance confirmation.
RU-10.key_parameters: 9/26/52 standard; RU schools often 120-period displacement variants on MOEX dailies.
RU-10.duplicates_eliminated: TR-11 Ichimoku (the parent); RU/UA course forks.

RU-11.name: Automated Fibonacci Level Robots
RU-11.origin: MT4-era RU automation (2000s-2010s); MQL5 CodeBase corpus.
RU-11.core_idea: Automatically anchor Fibonacci retracements to the last significant zigzag swing and post limit orders at 38.2/50/61.8 with stops beyond 78.6 — the mechanization of the single most-taught manual tool in RU technical courses. Variants add trend filters (only trade retracements in trend direction) and cluster confluence with round numbers (PA-16).
RU-11.rules: Detect swing (zigzag); place limit grid at ratios; cancel on invalidation; trail after 61.8 retrace resumes the trend.
RU-11.key_parameters: Zigzag 3-8%; ratio set; confluence tolerance 0.1 ATR.
RU-11.duplicates_eliminated: GR-05 Fibonacci grid (the averaging form); RU-03 Sniper (level-logic cousin).

RU-12.name: Brent-Urals & Calendar Spread Trading (TSLab)
RU-12.core_idea: Trade structural spreads: Brent-Urals quality differential around its geopolitical band, and same-instrument calendar spreads around fair carry. The RU educational corpus treats spread trading as the 'calm' alternative to directional futures, with TSLab's visual builder as the standard implementation environment. Sizing is beta-hedged to the lead leg.
RU-12.rules: Model the spread band (carry for calendars, quality/logistics for Brent-Urals); fade band extremes; exit at mean or band rationalization.
RU-12.key_parameters: Band lookback 60-250 days; hedge ratio; roll-calendar handling.
RU-12.duplicates_eliminated: CN-24 cross-commodity spreads; ST-01/02 stat-arb; RU-06 synthetic bonds (rate-spread cousin).

RU-13.name: Book + Tape Hybrid (Стакан + Лента) Automation
RU-13.origin: QUIK Lua / StockSharp community scripts (2010s+); semi-HFT retail practice.
RU-13.core_idea: Automate the classic scalper's read: combine DOM imbalance (стакан) with trade-tape aggression (лента) — large prints at ask with thinning offers signal continuation; the bot posts immediate-or-cancel entries with hard tick stops. Latency, not signal, is the binding constraint, which caps its viability for retail — a fact the community documents candidly. Included as the RU-native bridge between manual scalping and HFT.
RU-13.rules: Compute DOM imbalance + tape aggression score; enter IOC on confluence; exit on tape reversal or tick stop.
RU-13.key_parameters: Imbalance thresholds; tick stop 3-10 ticks; max holding seconds.
RU-13.duplicates_eliminated: RU-05 (manual form); VO-09 (Pine proxy); HFT microstructure literature.

RU-14.name: Smart-Lab Community Trend Robots (Si/RTS)
RU-14.origin: Smart-Lab.ru blog corpus (2010s+); public robot threads and lecture series.
RU-14.core_idea: The community's workhorse trend systems on MOEX futures: Donchian/MA-channel entries with ATR stops and Si/RTS-specific filters (session windows, spread-point vol normalization, squeeze-of-the-day gates). Their published equity curves, parameter walks, and failure post-mortems form an unusually honest public archive. Representative rather than a single recipe — the family's contribution is the documentation culture itself.
RU-14.rules: Channel/MA trend entry; ATR stop; session filter (day session only); volatility-normalized sizing.
RU-14.key_parameters: Entry 20-55 bars; ATR 2-3 x stop; per-contract risk caps.

RU-15.name: T-Bank Community Auto-Strategies (Tinkoff API era)
RU-15.origin: Tinkoff Investments open API (2018+); RU retail-bot community (github/ecosystem).
RU-15.core_idea: The open-broker API spawned a generation of retail bots: scheduled DCA with dip-boosts, threshold rebalancing, dividend-calendar loaders, and simple MA regime switches — all sharing the constraint of T+1 settlement and no shorting on the standard account. The family matters as the modern RU retail baseline, analogous to the US 'robo-advisor plus API' wave.
RU-15.rules: Regime gate (price vs 200-day MA) for contributions; DCA tranches; rebalance bands; dividend-date awareness.
RU-15.key_parameters: Contribution schedule; regime MA 200; rebalance threshold 10-20%.
RU-15.duplicates_eliminated: GR-04 DCA; GR-07 rebalancing (mechanisms); RU-07 dividend calendar integration.

RU-16.name: Academic Quant Lineage (ВШЭ / МФТИ factor studies)
RU-16.origin: HSE/MIPT quant programs and preprints (2010s+); RU brokerage research desks.
RU-16.core_idea: The RU academic track replicates global factor zoo results on MOEX data: momentum's weakness, value's persistence, liquidity premia, and low-vol anomalies under sanctions-era market structure. Practical output is factor-screens and rotation models distributed via brokerage research. Included because 'thinktank and database' coverage of the RU space centers on this lineage rather than on retail blogs.
RU-16.rules: Replicate factor definitions (Fama-French/Barra analogs) on MOEX universe; rank by factor score; test with transaction costs and illiquidity caps.
RU-16.key_parameters: Factor windows per paper; universe filters (free float, liquidity).
RU-16.duplicates_eliminated: ST-04..ST-11 (the global canon it replicates); CN-15 (the CN counterpart lineage).

ST-01.name: Pairs Trading (Distance Method)
ST-01.origin: Gatev, Goetzmann & Rouwenhorst, working paper 1999 / RFS 2006.
ST-01.core_idea: Find historically co-moving pairs, trade their normalized spread at +/-2 sigma, exit at convergence — market-neutral by construction. The paper's 1962-1996 US data showed mid-single-digit annual Sharpe-healthy returns; later replication shows decayed but persistent edges, concentrated in less-efficient markets. It is the parent of every stat-arb simplification including CN-24 and RU-08.
ST-01.rules: Form pairs on 12-month normalized distance; trade beyond 2 sigma; exit at zero crossing or 6-month time stop; stop-loss at 3+ sigma.
ST-01.key_parameters: Formation 12 months; trading 6 months; sigma bands 2.0/0; universe liquidity filter.
ST-01.duplicates_eliminated: RU-08 MOEX pairs; CN-24 commodity spreads; RU «парный трейдинг» community (mechanism identical).

ST-02.name: Statistical Arbitrage (Avellaneda-Lee)
ST-02.origin: Marco Avellaneda & Jeong-Hyun Lee, 'Statistical Arbitrage in the US Equities Market', Quantitative Finance 2010.
ST-02.core_idea: Decompose stock returns into a statistical risk model (PCA factors) plus residual; trade mean-reversion of residual idiosyncratic returns whose speed-of-mean-reversion (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck) is fast enough to clear costs. The paper formalized how much of the classic pairs edge lives in the residual, and provided the OU half-life screen that practitioners still use as the go/no-go gate.
ST-02.rules: Estimate factor model; compute residual OU parameters; trade residuals with half-life < 20 days at +/-2 sigma; exit at mean.
ST-02.key_parameters: PCA 10-15 factors; half-life cap 15-25 days; band 1.5-2.5 sigma.

ST-03.name: Kalman-Filter Hedge Ratio (Dynamic Pairs)
ST-03.alt_names: 卡尔曼滤波对冲比率 · Фильтр Калмана в парах
ST-03.origin: Signal-processing adaptation popularized in quant blogs (2010s, e.g., QuantStart lineage).
